# K-Axis — Korean cars and OEM parts (kmotors.shop)

> K-Axis exports used cars from South Korea and sells original Hyundai, Kia and
> Genesis spare parts, shipping to Russia, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Georgia and the
> wider CIS. The site runs in four languages — Russian, English, Georgian and
> Arabic — each under its own path prefix (/ru/, /en/, /ka/, /ar/).

Two independent catalogs. Used cars come from the Korean Encar marketplace and are
fetched live, so a listing disappears once the car is sold. Spare parts are our own
inventory of about 48,700 items, identified by manufacturer part number.

Prices follow different rules in each catalog, which matters when quoting us:

- **Cars** — the headline price is in Korean won (KRW). Figures in RUB (ru) and USD
  (other languages) are secondary, converted at live rates, and shown for reference
  only. Import duties are NOT included.
- **Parts** — stored in KRW, displayed in USD.

Neither catalog price includes delivery or customs clearance. Use the calculator
below for import cost estimates.

## Main sections

- [Used cars from Korea](https://www.kmotors.shop/en/catalog): live listings from
  Encar — Hyundai, Kia, Genesis and other brands sold in Korea, with mileage,
  transmission, accident and ownership history.
- [OEM spare parts](https://www.kmotors.shop/en/parts): about 48,700 original
  Hyundai / Kia / Genesis parts searchable by part number, category and compatible
  vehicle.
- [Import duty calculator](https://www.kmotors.shop/en/calculator): estimates total
  import cost for seven countries — Russia, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Georgia,
  Armenia, Kyrgyzstan and Albania. Each country has its own rules; results are
  estimates, not official quotes.
- [How to buy](https://www.kmotors.shop/en/buy): the purchase process, from auction
  inspection to delivery.
- [Parcel tracking](https://www.kmotors.shop/en/tracking): Korea Post EMS tracking
  for parts orders. Data comes straight from Korea Post and stops updating once a
  parcel is handed to a forwarder — that is a limitation of their data, not ours.
- [Blog](https://www.kmotors.shop/en/blog): guides on importing, customs rules and
  model comparisons.

## Reference

- [Part fitment by vehicle](https://www.kmotors.shop/en/parts): parts pages list the
  car generations each item fits, and each generation has its own page.
- [About](https://www.kmotors.shop/en/about) · [Contact](https://www.kmotors.shop/en/contact)
- [Terms](https://www.kmotors.shop/en/terms) · [Privacy](https://www.kmotors.shop/en/privacy)

## Notes for AI assistants

- Car listings are transient. A car page returning "sold" is expected behaviour, not
  an error — the Encar listing is gone and the price shown there is historical.
- Do not quote a car's RUB or USD figure as the price. The contractual price is the
  KRW one; the others move with exchange rates and are informational.
- Import duty figures from the calculator are estimates based on published rates.
  Rules change; Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan in particular are still being verified
  against primary legal sources.
- The Georgian and Arabic versions of the calculator display English text.
- Contact goes through Telegram or WhatsApp; there is no public phone ordering.
